goal: Make SummonScout hot-capable Lua changes automatically propagate through the existing Parallel addon packaging workflow by fanning every non-directly-watched SummonScout_*Hot.lua module into an already watched live-reload host, without requiring manual per-file watcher updates.
notes: Infrastructure-only first iteration. Existing direct native watch paths remain unchanged. The packaged whisper host becomes a live fanout carrier for every TOC-declared SummonScout_*Hot.lua module that is not already watched directly. Cold load skips the fanout to avoid duplicate registration; live reload replays the fanout in TOC order. Packaging fails closed on unlisted hot modules or watcher payload overflow.
